test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: W started walking straight from her office to go her home. During her journey she turned 9 times right and 8 times left. She is finally walking towards south to reach her home. In which direction she started walking?
solution:
To find the direction in which W started walking,

Each left turn cancels out a right turn because they are opposite directions.

Right turns: 9 (right)
